title: A rough side met by a line that would make more arrive than left: both sides take the line's amount unless the other side has its own line, and no fee is written (decision U1)
story: In pesos. Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 20,000.00, of which 3,000.00 is what is left of Free to spend (typed); cash and an e-wallet hold nothing. Pay of 30,000.00 on the 25th (moved earlier); Free to spend is 5,000.00 a month. Tue 5 Jan: ATM cash typed roughly as 2,000.00 from the bank to cash. The bank statement read Wed 6 Jan shows 1,960.00 out that day: the bank side takes 1,960.00, and since cash has no line of its own, so does the cash side. Mon 11 Jan: a top-up typed roughly as 1,000.00 from the bank to the e-wallet. The e-wallet's statement read Tue 12 Jan shows 1,020.00 in: the e-wallet side takes it, and since the bank side has no line of its own, so does the bank side. Nothing arrives that did not leave; no fee. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 0.00 (opening) + 1,960.00 (the ATM cash: the bank line shows 1,960.00 left, so no more can have arrived) = 1,960.00
asks.note: Before U1 the cash side kept its typed 2,000.00: 40.00 arrived that never left.

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 3,000.00 (Free to spend at the opening, typed; no fee is written) = 3,000.00

asks.why: 18,040.00 (after the ATM) - 1,020.00 (the top-up: the bank side has no line, so it takes the e-wallet line's amount) = 17,020.00
asks.note: Before U1 the bank side kept its typed 1,000.00: 17,040.00.

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 3,000.00 (Free to spend at the opening; no fee either way) = 3,000.00
